This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 01/07/2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Summit Medical
Devices Inc, with its registered office at 1200 Industrial Parkway, Austin ("Party A"), and Summit Medical Devices Inc, with its registered
office at 88 Commerce Drive, Denver ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 36 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in accordance with
Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the purposes of this
Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York.

Signatures

Party A    Summit Medical Devices Inc / Sarah Mitchell
Party B    Summit Medical Devices Inc / Maria Lopez
